description: Capture ledger versions for the rrt-position-capture schema. Levels 5..19 form an ordered, cumulative evidence ladder emitted on the multi-draw path; the proxy's environment parser refuses a level whose predecessor is not enabled, so the header version is the highest enabled level rather than an independent set of flags. Levels 2..4 are emitted by the other header paths. Level 1 is legacy and no longer produced. Adding a level means updating this file, the CaptureLevel enum and Level() in src/shader/intercept.cpp, and the accepted set in tools/inspect_position_capture.py; tests/verify_capture_version_contract.py fails if they disagree.

legacy.evidence: legacy position capture; accepted by the reader but no longer produced
